svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-overblouse-female","name":"Women's White Overblouse: short-sleeve princess-line overblouse, pointed collar, gray skirt (blank slots)","size_in":{"w":27.3589,"h":29.4881},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,2735.89,2948.81],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"Silhouette traced from Vanguard's product photo of the CAP women's white overblouse (smoothed, mirrored) and scaled to 21.0 in sleeve-to-sleeve (estimate); chest width then reads about 10 in flat. No real garment was measured. The sleeves are then widened (dimensions.sleeve_widening); the bodice keeps the 21.0 in scale. Then the whole sheet is scaled by 1.2037 (LIVE-ART2 item 1): the men's aviator shirt's traced pocket is 4.36 in wide and a USAF-style men's size-M short-sleeve shirt pocket is about 5.25 x 6 in (ESTIMATE: AF shirt pattern dimension supplied with the task, no CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903 dimension); the overblouse has no pocket and is the women's piece of the 4.2.6 aviator uniform, so it takes the aviator shirts' factor (sleeve to sleeve 21.0 in becomes 25.3 in before widening). The nametag slot (centre 1 1/2 in below the first button, 4.2.6.2.6.1.2) and ribbon slot keep their true
